name: Liquidity-sweep and recovery
hypothesis: Fade only after recovery is observed with a repaired, current order book.
spec: Setup: A burst consumes several levels and price subsequently recovers a pre-existing reference. Entry: Fade only after recovery is observed with a repaired, current order book. Exit: Stop beyond sweep extreme; exit at normal reference or short timeout. Parameters to pre-register: sweep_definition, recovery_level, confirmation, max_hold.
blocked_reason: needs a sequenced L2/L3 order-book feed; the free venues give periodic snapshots only
